comment: Evaluation scenario pool for the planner/composer ladder. 'expect' is the anticipated route: registered (deterministic workflow, ready), needs_input (workflow matched, params missing -> HIL), composed (composer should build a valid plan from existing tools), gap (request needs capabilities the tool registry does not have yet - we WANT these to fail informatively), clarification (the composer should ask a structured follow-up question rather than guess or bluntly refuse). 'gaps' names the missing capabilities so results can be aggregated into a build list.

scenarios.title: Named street buffer, different city
scenarios.prompt: Eskişehir'deki "İsmet İnönü Caddesi" için 30 m buffer uygula
scenarios.notes: Deterministic path; tests place/street/distance extraction outside Kutahya.

scenarios.title: File quality preflight
scenarios.prompt: Şu dosyaya veri kontrolü yap: /data/parseller.shp
scenarios.notes: preflight_quality_check via 'veri kontrolu' pattern + path extraction.

scenarios.title: CRS conversion without output dir
scenarios.prompt: Convert CRS of /data/hatlar.gpkg to EPSG:5256
scenarios.notes: crs_normalization matches; output_dir is not extractable -> HIL question.

scenarios.title: Road fetch without buffer parameters
scenarios.prompt: Bursa'daki tüm yolları haritaya çek
scenarios.notes: road_fetch_and_buffer matched; street_name and buffer_m missing -> HIL.

scenarios.title: School proximity rental search, new city
scenarios.prompt: Eskişehir Odunpazarı'nda okullara 400 metre ve ana yollara 200 metre mesafede kiralık ev aramaya uygun bölgeleri çıkar
scenarios.notes: Reference multi-criteria pattern: boundary, amenity=school, highway filter, reproject, buffers, intersect.

scenarios.title: Pharmacy coverage gaps
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya merkezde eczanelerin 300 metre yürüme çevresi dışında kalan alanları göster
scenarios.notes: amenity=pharmacy buffer, then difference against the boundary polygon. Boundary must be reprojected to the same metric CRS before difference.

scenarios.title: Parks near main roads
scenarios.prompt: Find parks in Kutahya that lie within 400 metres of primary or secondary roads
scenarios.notes: leisure=park + highway in_values filter + buffer + intersect.

scenarios.title: Industrial-residential conflict zones
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya'da sanayi alanlarının 500 metre etki mesafesi içinde kalan konut alanlarını tespit et
scenarios.notes: landuse=industrial buffer vs landuse=residential intersect; two fetches, shared metric CRS.

scenarios.title: Hospital access dead zones
scenarios.prompt: Show the parts of Kutahya that are farther than 1 kilometre from any hospital
scenarios.notes: amenity=hospital buffer 1000 m, difference from city polygon. Tests km->m conversion.

scenarios.title: Stream protection corridor
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya'daki akarsuların 100 metrelik koruma bandını çıkar ve ilçe sınırına göre kırp
scenarios.notes: waterway=* fetch, buffer, clip to boundary (boundary must be in the same CRS -> reproject).

scenarios.title: Railway noise corridor over housing
scenarios.prompt: Demiryolunun 250 metre gürültü koridorunda kalan konut bölgelerini Kütahya için haritala
scenarios.notes: railway=rail fetch + buffer + intersect with landuse=residential.

scenarios.title: Double proximity criteria
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya Evliya Çelebi Mahallesi'nde hem camiye 300 metre hem markete 200 metre mesafede olan bölgeleri bul
scenarios.notes: amenity=place_of_worship and shop=supermarket buffers intersected inside neighborhood.

scenarios.title: Enrich uploaded points with landuse
scenarios.prompt: Take my subscriber points at /data/aboneler.geojson and attach the OSM landuse class each point falls in, for Kutahya
scenarios.notes: load_vector + fetch landuse polygons + spatial_join (CRS alignment required).

scenarios.title: Dissolve parcels by neighborhood field
scenarios.prompt: /data/parseller.gpkg dosyasındaki parselleri mahalle_adi alanına göre birleştir ve GeoPackage olarak /out klasörüne paketle
scenarios.notes: load_vector + dissolve(by) + package_outputs.

scenarios.title: Repair then export
scenarios.prompt: My file /data/binalar.shp has broken geometries; repair them and export a clean GeoJSON to /out/binalar_clean.geojson
scenarios.notes: load_vector + repair_geometry + save_vector(GeoJSON).

scenarios.title: Footpaths inside parks
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya'daki parkların içinden geçen yaya yollarını çıkar
scenarios.notes: highway=footway fetch + leisure=park fetch + clip/intersect with shared CRS.

scenarios.title: Bus stop coverage gaps
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya'da otobüs duraklarının 400 metre erişim alanı dışında kalan yerleşim bölgelerini bul
scenarios.notes: highway=bus_stop buffer, residential landuse, difference.

scenarios.title: Uploaded plan vs cemetery setback
scenarios.prompt: /data/imar_taslak.gpkg dosyasındaki öneri konut adalarından mezarlıkların 250 metre yakınında kalanları tespit et, Kütahya için
scenarios.notes: Uploaded file with unknown CRS + landuse=cemetery buffer + intersect. Stresses detect/reproject discipline on user data.

scenarios.title: Two-district comparison package
scenarios.prompt: Fetch the boundaries of Tavsanli and Simav districts in Kutahya province, get the named main roads in each, and deliver everything as one package to /out/districts
scenarios.notes: Two boundary fetches, two feature fetches, filter, package_outputs with layer collection. Long chain (>= 7 steps).

scenarios.title: Pedestrian street corridor
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya merkezdeki isimli yaya caddelerini bul ve her biri için 15 metrelik koridor oluştur
scenarios.notes: highway=pedestrian with require_tags name, reproject, buffer.

scenarios.title: Fuel station vs school safety overlap
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya'da akaryakıt istasyonlarının 100 metre emniyet mesafesi ile okulların 100 metre çevresinin çakıştığı yerleri göster
scenarios.notes: amenity=fuel and amenity=school buffers intersected.

scenarios.title: Clip uploaded utility lines
scenarios.prompt: Clip my water network file /data/su_hatti.gpkg to the Yildirim Beyazit neighborhood boundary in Kutahya and package the result to /out/su
scenarios.notes: load + boundary fetch + CRS alignment + clip + package.

scenarios.title: Residential areas far from green space
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya'da herhangi bir yeşil alana 500 metreden uzak konut bölgelerini çıkar
scenarios.notes: leisure=park buffer + residential landuse difference.

scenarios.title: Solar plant siting negative screen
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya'da konut alanlarına 500 metreden uzak, ana yollara ise en fazla 300 metre mesafede güneş santrali kurulabilecek bölgeleri belirle
scenarios.notes: Positive criterion (road buffer intersect) + negative criterion (residential buffer difference) combined.

scenarios.title: Historic protection ring vs roads
scenarios.prompt: Which named roads in Kutahya pass within 200 metres of a historic site? Deliver them as GeoJSON to /out/historic_roads.geojson
scenarios.notes: historic=* buffer + named highway intersect + save_vector.

scenarios.title: Degree-based buffer trap
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya'daki dereler için 0.001 derece tampon oluştur
scenarios.notes: TRAP: distances in degrees are geodetically meaningless. Increment 3 (Composer ClarificationRequest): the composer now asks a structured clarification (e.g. 'did you mean ~111 m?') instead of bluntly refusing. Previously expect=gap/composed_refused (Run 2 verdict); the degree_distance_clarification capability has graduated from tracked gap to implemented clarification flow. Kept in gaps for historical/build-list continuity, not read by _EXPECT_OK.

scenarios.title: Explicit wrong-CRS instruction
scenarios.prompt: Buffer the streams of Kutahya by 50 metres and do all the processing in EPSG:4326 please
scenarios.notes: TRAP: user explicitly requests a geographic CRS for a metric operation. The validator must force a metric CRS regardless; the plan should not obey the user's CRS wish.

scenarios.title: Eastern Turkey CRS zone choice
scenarios.prompt: Erzurum'daki hastanelerin 750 metre hizmet alanını çıkar
scenarios.notes: EPSG:5254 (TM30) is WRONG for Erzurum (~41.3E); correct is TM42/EPSG:5258 or UTM 38N. Reveals whether the composer hardcodes 5254. Validation passes either way (both metric) - review plans manually.

scenarios.title: Foot-based CRS suggestion
scenarios.prompt: Use the Texas Central ftUS coordinate system to buffer Kutahya schools by 300 metres
scenarios.notes: TRAP: EPSG:2277 is projected but foot-based; static checker classifies it non-metric and must reject any plan that buffers in it.

scenarios.title: CSV coordinate table to points
scenarios.prompt: /data/rogar_kapaklari.csv dosyasında TM30 x ve y kolonları var; bunları nokta katmanına çevirip mahalle sınırına göre kırp
scenarios.notes: Brief lists csv_to_point_layer; not built yet. load_vector may read CSV via pyogrio but without geometry - the CRS/coordinate-column mapping tool is missing.

scenarios.title: Mixed-CRS overlay discipline
scenarios.prompt: Overlay my EPSG:4326 field survey polygons at /data/arazi.geojson with Kutahya's industrial zones and report the overlapping areas as a package to /out/overlap
scenarios.notes: Both inputs must be brought to one metric CRS before intersect; same-CRS rule enforced by the tools.

scenarios.title: Legacy datum transformation
scenarios.prompt: ED50 datumundaki /data/eski_parseller.shp dosyasını TUREF TM30'a dönüştürüp /out/parseller klasörüne paketle
scenarios.notes: Datum shift ED50->TUREF via pyproj; composable with load + reproject + package. Accuracy of the transformation pipeline is a later QA topic.

scenarios.title: Area statistics per polygon
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya'daki her parkın alanını hektar cinsinden hesapla ve listele
scenarios.notes: calculate_area is in the brief's tool list but not built. Also needs tabular output, not just layers.

scenarios.title: Total length of a network
scenarios.prompt: How many kilometres of cycleway does Kutahya have in total?
scenarios.notes: calculate_length missing; also the product currently returns layers, not scalar answers.

scenarios.title: Point-in-polygon counting
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya'da her mahallede kaç adet bina olduğunu say ve mahalle bazında raporla
scenarios.notes: No aggregation/count tool; also needs neighborhood-level boundaries (multiple admin polygons), not a single boundary.

scenarios.title: Nearest-facility distance
scenarios.prompt: For every building in Kutahya centre, compute the distance to the nearest fire station and flag buildings farther than 2 km
scenarios.notes: Needs a nearest/distance tool (sjoin_nearest). Buffer+difference can approximate the flagging but not per-feature distances.

scenarios.title: Routing
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya tren garından Dumlupınar Üniversitesi'ne araçla en kısa güzergahı hesapla
scenarios.notes: Network routing (pgRouting, Phase 5). No routing capability exists.

scenarios.title: Isochrone
scenarios.prompt: Draw the 10-minute walking area around Kutahya city hospital
scenarios.notes: Time-based accessibility needs a network model; crude circular buffer (~800 m) would be a misleading substitute - refusing is better than faking.

scenarios.title: Accident density heatmap
scenarios.prompt: /data/kazalar.csv dosyasındaki trafik kazalarının yoğunluk haritasını çıkar
scenarios.notes: Needs CSV point import + density/heatmap raster or hexbin capability.

scenarios.title: DEM slope screening
scenarios.prompt: Identify areas in Kutahya with terrain slope above 20 percent that should be excluded from development
scenarios.notes: No raster stack at all (rasterio in the brief, not yet wired).

scenarios.title: Zonal statistics
scenarios.prompt: /data/parseller.gpkg içindeki her parsel için ortalama arazi eğimini hesapla
scenarios.notes: Raster + zonal stats missing.

scenarios.title: Address geocoding
scenarios.prompt: /data/musteri_adresleri.csv dosyasındaki adresleri koordinata çevirip harita katmanı yap
scenarios.notes: Nominatim gateway exists for boundaries only; bulk address geocoding tool is missing (and has rate-limit implications).

scenarios.title: Centroid generation
scenarios.prompt: Create labelled centre points for every parcel in /data/parseller.gpkg and export as GeoJSON
scenarios.notes: One-liner in geopandas; tool not registered yet. Cheap win.

scenarios.title: Geometry simplification
scenarios.prompt: Simplify the geometries in /data/mahalleler.gpkg with 5 metre tolerance for web display and save as GeoJSON
scenarios.notes: Douglas-Peucker via shapely; tool missing. Note: tolerance implies metric CRS - good geodesy test when built.

scenarios.title: Voronoi service areas
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya'daki aile sağlığı merkezlerinin Voronoi hizmet bölgelerini oluştur
scenarios.notes: shapely voronoi_diagram exists; tool not registered.

scenarios.title: Hex-grid density
scenarios.prompt: Build a 500 m hexagon grid over Kutahya and colour it by the number of shops in each cell
scenarios.notes: Grid generation + aggregation both missing.

scenarios.title: Multi-ring impact zones
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya şeker fabrikası çevresinde 100, 300 ve 500 metrelik etki halkaları oluştur ve her halkada kalan konut alanlarını ayrı katmanlar olarak paketle
scenarios.notes: STRETCH: possible with buffers + difference (ring = larger minus smaller) + intersects + package, but the chain is long (~12 steps). Tests composer at the MAX_STEPS boundary.

scenarios.title: Folder-wide merge
scenarios.prompt: /data/ilceler/ klasöründeki bütün shapefile'ları tek bir GeoPackage'ta birleştir
scenarios.notes: Phase 3 batch processing + a merge/append tool are both missing.

scenarios.title: DXF delivery for CAD
scenarios.prompt: Kütahya'daki ana yolları Netcad'de açabileceğim şekilde DXF olarak /out/yollar.dxf dosyasına ver
scenarios.notes: Brief requires DXF output; save_vector currently supports GPKG/GeoJSON/Shapefile only.

scenarios.title: KML delivery for Google Earth
scenarios.prompt: Export Kutahya's parks as a KML file I can open in Google Earth, to /out/parklar.kml
scenarios.notes: KML is in the brief's output format list; not wired into save_vector yet.
